changes.comment: The model refuses two names that differ only in case, a `slugField` that is not a slug, a lower bound above an upper one, and a default that is not a valid value. `readManifest` reads a manifest for every reader: an unknown field option makes its collection read-only, and a manifest without the protocol envelope is refused. Slugs without `_order.json` are in code-unit order; text sorts in one fixed collation; date bounds and sorts compare dates. Option types are the field types without `kind`, an object is never null, and `multiple` is `true` or absent.
